### Fixed
- **`muster get prompt <name>` and `muster get resource <uri>` find every aggregated prompt and resource, and their completion offers them.** Both looked the item up in the native `prompts/list` and `resources/list` of the CLI's session, which carry muster's own resources (`auth://status`) but none of the aggregated servers' items, so they answered `prompt not found` / `resource not found` for every prompt and resource of a backend, and completion offered none. `get prompt` now reads the prompt through `describe_prompt` and `get resource` through `describe_resource`, which report the server and a prompt's arguments; muster's own items, which only the native listing has, are still found there. The detail shows the server. A URI several servers expose answers with the servers' names and is picked with the new `muster get resource <uri> --server <name>`. Completion lists through `list_prompts` and `list_resources`, as `muster list prompt|resource` does, and the completion of `get`, `call` and `start` asks the aggregator `--endpoint` and `--context` (or `MUSTER_ENDPOINT`, `MUSTER_CONTEXT`) name instead of always the default context. ([#1393](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1393))
